library.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible
library.description: Typeface designed for maximum legibility for readers with low vision, used by the "Fonte Legível" option. Packaged locally (WOFF2, Regular weight, Latin subset) instead of loaded from Google Fonts, for institutional CDN-blocking/privacy reasons - see DECISIONS.md. License text: fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible.txt.

library.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible
library.description: Typeface designed for maximum legibility for readers with low vision, used by the "Fonte Legível" option. Packaged locally (WOFF2, Bold weight, Latin subset) instead of loaded from Google Fonts, for institutional CDN-blocking/privacy reasons - see DECISIONS.md. License text: fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible.txt.

library.name: Lexend
library.description: Variable-weight typeface researched to improve reading fluency, used by the "Fonte para Dislexia" option. Packaged locally (WOFF2, variable, Latin subset) instead of loaded from Google Fonts, for institutional CDN-blocking/privacy reasons - see DECISIONS.md. License text: fonts/OFL-lexend.txt.

library.name: OpenDyslexic
library.description: Typeface designed to increase readability for readers with dyslexia (weighted bottoms, wide default spacing), offered as a second choice alongside Lexend in the "Fonte para Dislexia" option. Packaged locally (WOFF2, Regular weight) instead of loaded from a CDN, for institutional CDN-blocking/privacy reasons - see DECISIONS.md. License text: fonts/OFL-opendyslexic.txt.

copyrights.copyright: 2019 Abbie Gonzalez (https://abbiecod.es), with Reserved Font Name OpenDyslexic

library.name: OpenDyslexic
library.description: Same typeface as above, Bold weight - used for the bold word-prefix in the Bionic Reading option and any other bold text when "Fonte para Dislexia" is set to OpenDyslexic. Packaged locally, same terms. License text: fonts/OFL-opendyslexic.txt.

copyrights.copyright: 2019 Abbie Gonzalez (https://abbiecod.es), with Reserved Font Name OpenDyslexic

library.name: MediaPipe Tasks Vision (WASM loader, SIMD)
library.description: WebAssembly loader glue for the face-tracking pipeline used by the "Navegação por Face" option. Packaged locally (was loaded from jsDelivr's CDN) so this plugin no longer depends on a third-party CDN at runtime for it - see DECISIONS.md D78. The corresponding .task model file is deliberately NOT bundled here (fetched live and hash-verified instead - see amd/src/face_navigation.js's own MP_MODEL_SHA256 comment for why). License text: mediapipe/LICENSE-mediapipe.txt.

library.name: MediaPipe Tasks Vision (WASM binary, SIMD)
library.description: WebAssembly binary for the face-tracking pipeline used by the "Navegação por Face" option, SIMD-capable-browser variant. Packaged locally - see the .js entry above for the full reasoning. License text: mediapipe/LICENSE-mediapipe.txt.

library.name: MediaPipe Tasks Vision (WASM loader, non-SIMD)
library.description: Same as vision_wasm_internal.js above, for browsers without WebAssembly SIMD support - FilesetResolver picks between the two variants itself. License text: mediapipe/LICENSE-mediapipe.txt.

library.name: MediaPipe Tasks Vision (WASM binary, non-SIMD)
library.description: Same as vision_wasm_internal.wasm above, for browsers without WebAssembly SIMD support. License text: mediapipe/LICENSE-mediapipe.txt.

library.name: Ionicons - accessibility icon
library.description: Generic accessibility figure icon, used as the default FAB icon since D60. Downloaded via svgrepo.com (listed as "Ionicons Filled Interface Icons", author "Ionicons"); confirmed against the upstream Ionicons repository. Re-exported with fill="#000000" replaced by fill="currentColor" so the icon themes like every other icon in classes/icons.php. Path geometry unchanged from the source.

library.name: Accessibility logo (UN)
library.description: International accessibility symbol, used as one of the FAB icon options ("Logo de acessibilidade da ONU"). Re-exported with the original <style>/CSS-class block replaced by equivalent inline presentation attributes so it can be safely inlined into a Moodle page; path/circle geometry unchanged from the source. Full attribution in README.md.

copyrights.copyright: United Nations, Graphic Design Unit (original design)
